# is-a-coder.in — Free Subdomains for Developers

> is-a-coder.in is a free, permanent subdomain service providing developers, software engineers, and researchers with custom `username.is-a-coder.in` domains.

## What is is-a-coder.in?
is-a-coder.in allows developers worldwide to claim free subdomains pointing to their GitHub Pages, Vercel apps, Netlify sites, or VPS IP addresses.

## Key Features
- **Instant Availability Checking**: Real-time validation for subdomains.
- **DNS Record Types**: Supports CNAME, A, AAAA, and TXT records.
- **Security & SSL**: Free automatic TLS 1.3 encryption.
- **Self-Service Web Dashboard**: Users can register and track their domain statuses in real-time.
- **Admin Review**: Safe, anti-abuse protected approval workflow.

## Usage & API
- Web Homepage: https://is-a-coder.in
- User Login & Registration: https://is-a-coder.in/login
- Developer Dashboard: https://is-a-coder.in/dashboard
- Subdomain Availability API: GET https://is-a-coder.in/api/subdomains/check?name={subdomain}
- Terms of Service: https://is-a-coder.in/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://is-a-coder.in/privacy
